articles.summary: When fans attend events at Gesa Field, they will be greeted by a new video board and audio system from Daktronics (NASDAQ: DAKT), a recognized industry leader in digital display and control system technology, as Washington State University unveiled the technology upgrade this past weekend for the 2026 season in Pullman, Washington.
articles.title: Washington State University Unveils Upgraded Video and Audio System from Daktronics

articles.summary: Virginia Polytechnic Institute and State University (Virginia Tech) unveiled a new video board in the end zone of Lane Stadium from Daktronics (NASDAQ: DAKT), a recognized industry leader in digital display and control system technology.
articles.title: Virginia Tech Transforms Game-Day Experience with New Daktronics LED Display and Audio Solutions

articles.summary: Lamar Advertising, in collaboration with Daktronics (NASDAQ: DAKT), a recognized industry leader in digital display and control system technology, upgraded the billboard in Sioux Falls, South Dakota, which has served the market since 2008, to current technology designed to improve operating efficiency while keeping an established advertising location in service.
articles.title: Lamar Advertising Brings New Life to an 18-Year Sioux Falls Landmark with Daktronics Digital Technology
